dialogues.speaker: Boyan
dialogues.text: If tea's your thing, know that the "Chenyu Adeptea" of Chenyu Vale is the very best there is.

dialogues.speaker: Boyan
dialogues.text: But there's been trouble in the vale's water and soil, and the tea quality's dropped like a rock in a river!

dialogues.speaker: Boyan
dialogues.text: This has troubled me day and night, and I can think of only one solution...
